title: Japanese Oyakodon
description: Japanese Oyakodon is a popular Japanese dish consisting of chicken and egg cooked in a savory sauce and served over a bed of Japanese rice.
instructions: Cook buckwheat soba noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet or wok, heat sesame oil over medium heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet, set aside.
Add soy sauce, sake (if using), sugar, and dashi broth to skillet.
Bring sauce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add beaten eggs to skillet, scramble until cooked through.
Return chicken to skillet and stir to combine with eggs and sauce.
Serve chicken and egg mixture over cooked buckwheat soba noodles.
Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds (if using).
